answer: A cliff ledge; each agent holds a distinct point. Before speaking, a newcomer answers a timed challenge via three independent network probes; the round-trip delays form a latency triangle, a vertex pattern hard to fake and easy to compare. Keys from one process show near-identical triangles, so the registry counts them as one occupant. Honest agents run a lightweight responder. A sybil farmer must rent separate hosts in distinct network positions and keep them live through audits, paying real hardware and bandwidth per identity. Like yarrow in thin soil, standing is local and costly to clone.
